features.name: Test Explorer support
features.description: New support for test explorer in AL development that allows developers to run and debug tests directly in the editor without needing a custom AL test runner, showing test results, call stacks, and assert messages inline.
caveats: Test explorer requires codeunits marked with test attribute

features.name: Propagated dependencies
features.description: A feature that allows developers to refactor apps into multiple other apps while reusing components without breaking external contracts by lifting dependencies as proxies in the manifest.
caveats: Propagated dependencies only work for one level, cannot point to another propagated dependency

features.name: Test library properties
features.description: New AL properties for test codeunits including required test permissions, test type (unit or integration), and required test isolation (transaction rollback behavior) to support test explorer and CI/CD pipelines.
caveats: Security concern that anybody can specify internal visible to app ID in production

features.name: Internal visible to property
features.description: AL language feature that allows marking procedures as internal and only callable from specified apps, enabling secure exposure of test facades and internal methods for testing purposes.
caveats: Security concern as anybody can specify app ID for internal visible to in production

features.name: AI test agent
features.description: An agent that can write tests interactively in GitHub Copilot Chat by reading the workspace, identifying test scenarios, generating test code, and running tests with tools for build and publish.
caveats: May take time to generate tests
Test generation may not always produce working tests immediately

features.name: Test-generating agent for bug reproduction
features.description: An agent that can analyze code and automatically generate tests to reproduce issues, run interactively in GitHub Copilot Chat interface. Accepts task descriptions and produces test code.
caveats: agent may need multiple iterations to properly reproduce the issue
test may initially pass even if the issue is present

features.name: AI test with data-driven permutations
features.description: Testing paradigm for AI features where instead of hardcoded assertions, tests use data sets containing multiple permutations of inputs, prompts, models, and expected outcomes. Data sets are the source of truth about test behavior.
caveats: requires understanding the distinction between agent tests and AI tests
data sets should contain all relevant permutations for meaningful results

features.name: AI test artifacts and multiple executions
features.description: AI tests produce artifacts including data sets, assertions, and metrics that are stored and rerun multiple times. This enables averaging across runs and detecting whether AI is moving in the right direction.
caveats: non-deterministic nature of AI means single test result is insufficient
requires tracking multiple dimensions: prompt, input, output, model

features.name: Copilot feature testing framework
features.description: Testing framework for LLM-based copilot features using data sets with input and expected output pairs. Tests are run through the EI eval suite rather than the standard test tool.
caveats: requires installation code unit to load data from resources
must be run in EI eval suite not standard test tool
shown example had compiler service not running

features.name: Agentic test simulation and step verification
features.description: Testing framework for agents that simulates agentic actions and task steps using library agent simulation. Data sets include expected steps and user interventions that agents should perform.
caveats: uses library agent for simulation rather than direct function calls
data sets must define expected steps and interventions
different approach from copilot feature testing

features.name: Native data-driven test support
features.description: Coming feature for native support of data-driven tests in AL with test data source attributes. Allows test procedures to be invoked once per data point with custom context interface for accessing test case data.
caveats: not part of product yet
may be available in pre-release
requires implementing custom context interface for test case access

features.name: Custom context interface for data-driven tests
features.description: Allows test creators to extend a base interface and store needed information inside a code unit, exposing it in the most convenient way for individual test cases.
features.status_evidence_quote: This is what we have planned um for the pipeline for coming release
caveats: Shape of individual test cases cannot be known in advance

features.name: Agent-assisted test writing and review
features.description: Agents can write tests and delegate reviews for tests, making it easier to write tests that are more informative and have higher quality coverage.

features.name: Performance test suite for long-running tests
features.description: Toolkit for handling performance-critical tests with long execution times and big data sets, including database backups for data preparation.
caveats: Challenge to implement in regular pipelines when processes take a week or longer
No complete solution yet for detecting performance regressions from code changes

features.name: Test type filtering with subtype and transaction filters
features.description: Ability to filter tests by test type, subtype, transactions, code coverage, and namespaces to identify which tests need to run based on code changes.

features.name: Test code lens for developers
features.description: VS Code feature that shows developers which tests might be interesting to run when making changes to a specific function, based on code coverage data.

features.name: BTE code for faster inner loop testing
features.description: Ability to run tests in the inner loop much faster by focusing on logic tests rather than actual database transactions, enabling more effective development and agent execution.
caveats: Future improvement

features.name: Codespaces for multi-project environments
features.description: Virtual machines running VS Code in a browser with different configurations, setups, and launch configs, allowing developers to work on multiple projects without local installation.
caveats: Still requires an environment to run tests on

features.name: Docker containers for multiple environments
features.description: Using Docker containers as an option for managing multiple BC environments locally and for testing different project configurations.

features.name: Test isolation improvements with empty company
features.description: Moving tests to run on empty company by extracting unit tests from integration tests, reducing dependency on demo data and making tests more stable for future changes.
caveats: Existing integration tests remain dependent on demo data
Ongoing challenge to refactor legacy test code units

features.name: MCP server for test execution
features.description: Enables test execution through an MCP server, allowing tools other than VS Code to run tests, including agents and various harnesses.

features.name: VS Code test explorer for AI tests
features.description: Test explorer interface in VS Code that shows test execution results and integrates with AI agents for running and generating tests.

features.name: AI test runner with token consumption tracking
features.description: Web-based test runner that displays token consumption for AI-driven tests, helping developers understand the cost of running agent-assisted tests.
caveats: Demo did not show actual data because service was not running

features.name: Test optimization through model and instruction tuning
features.description: Users can experiment with different AI models, shorter agent instructions, and reduced token consumption by configuring agent profiles with less environmental data and only necessary actions.
caveats: Requires manual configuration and experimentation

features.name: Running tests from VS Code
features.description: Tests can be executed from VS Code as an alternative to the classic test explorer, but has compatibility issues with GUI-related code.
caveats: Tests using GUI-related code fail differently in VS Code versus client execution
Known issue that needs fixing

features.name: Test generation with MCP and external tools
features.description: Using MCPs you can use almost any tool to help generate and build AL tests and have them executed through external agents and harnesses.

features.name: Model optimization for test scenarios
features.description: Ability to choose different models for running tests, with consideration for cost efficiency - whether a scenario needs the latest model or can run on a better or lower-cost model.
